realtime_observation_unavailable.title: Realtime Rachio observation is unavailable
realtime_observation_unavailable.description: IrrigationOS could not enable realtime Rachio events: {reason}. Five-minute polling remains active. Configure an externally reachable HTTPS Home Assistant URL to enable push updates; Home Assistant Cloud is optional.

user.title: Connect IrrigationOS to Rachio
user.description: In the Rachio app, open Profile, select API Key, and tap Copy. Paste the key below. IrrigationOS validates the account before setup and starts in Observation mode.

confirm.title: Review discovered irrigation hardware
confirm.description: IrrigationOS found {controller_count} controller(s) and {area_count} irrigation area(s). Controllers: {controller_names}. Areas: {area_names}. Submit to finish setup in Observation mode.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect IrrigationOS to Rachio
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a current Rachio API key for this same account.

error.invalid_response: Rachio returned an unexpected account response.
error.rate_limited: Rachio is temporarily rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This Rachio account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different Rachio account.

init.title: Landscape Digital Twin
init.description: Select an irrigation area to review or edit.

area.title: Edit landscape profile
area.description: Edit the Landscape Digital Twin profile for {area_name}. Controller observations remain separate from these landscape facts.

error.invalid_profile: One or more landscape profile values are outside the allowed range.

abort.no_areas: No irrigation areas are currently available.
